question: Which emperor's reign saw great advancements in Mauryan architecture?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashoka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ashoka's reign** marked a significant period in Indian history, especially in terms of advancements in **Mauryan architecture**. He ruled from approximately **268 BCE to 232 BCE**.
 
• Ashoka is well-known for his efforts to spread **Buddhist philosophy**, which influenced the development of architectural styles like **stupas, pillars, and viharas**.
 
• The **Ashokan Pillars** are iconic examples of Mauryan architecture. These stone pillars, inscribed with **Edicts of Ashoka**, conveyed his messages of Dhamma (righteousness) and were erected across his empire.
 
• Ashoka commissioned the construction of the **Sanchi Stupa**, one of the most famous Buddhist monuments, which symbolizes the **enlightenment of Buddha**.
